description_en: Retrieves the details of a configuration export task for a Bastionhost instance
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-export-config-job --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --job-id 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetExportConfigJob

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
